claims.statement: Wallet wallet_eth_treasury exists on the Ethereum network with a non-zero balance at 2026-06-30.

DemoCo Treasury LLC controlled the signing key for wallet_eth_treasury at 2026-06-30, evidenced by a verified signed message over a dated challenge nonce, and the wallet is mapped to the entity in the approved entity mapping register. Control of a key at a point in time does not, by itself, establish legal or beneficial ownership; legal ownership is supported here by the entity mapping and treasury policy.
claims.conclusion: Control at period end is supported; ownership support rests on entity mapping and policy.

claims.statement: acct_btc_custodian is held by Demo Custody Inc. for the benefit of DemoCo Treasury LLC under a custody agreement, with 85.25 BTC held at 2026-06-30 per the custodian statement.
claims.conclusion: Custodial holding is supported by the statement and custody agreement mapping.

claims.statement: The 2026-Q2 reporting population consists of wallet_eth_treasury and acct_btc_custodian; every wallet in the inventory is either included in the population or excluded with a documented rationale.
claims.conclusion: Population is complete relative to the wallet inventory.

claims.statement: Period-end balances for the included wallets tie to source evidence: 1,250.5 ETH to the block explorer snapshot and 85.25 BTC to the custodian statement.
claims.conclusion: Balances tie to source evidence; downstream fair value measurement is out of scope for this work product.

claims.statement: wallet_test_legacy is excluded from the reporting population with a documented rationale: it is an engineering test wallet, never funded by treasury operations, with a zero balance at period end.
claims.conclusion: Exclusion is documented and consistent with treasury policy.
